args.body: TASK-179581681901 confirms that the restoration copy matches the shared private-quote candidate byte for byte. Ownership and consent to change shared files still require separate evidence. In SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-STANDALONE-RELEASE, use the isolated assembly handoff for the served inventory and tested download. If private-quote-intake-static-check.json commits, use it to flag any reproducible quote-template defect to the revision owner and keep repairs separate from the preview. Obtain a preview-only dry-run digest and route its exact inventory to an eligible independent reviewer when the host staging prerequisites are met. Reuse any finished result and keep the candidate staged.

description: Treasury reports no verified funding or revenue. Commercial feedback is available but includes five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The tested SQLite instructor preview applies to the saved live baseline, and a three-way merge with the private-quote draft failed. The restoration copy matches the shared draft byte for byte. Continue the isolated preview assembly and check the separate quote draft for defects that could stop a buyer from submitting a usable request. Advance the preview to host-enforced independent review when the served inventory is verified and the host returns an exact digest. An eligible request and administrative order acceptance would advance the paid route.
